'''Teensy Weensy''' is an NPC located in {{Location|Garden of the Lost|nocat=1}} and {{Location|Border Mountains|nocat=1}}.

It is a [[Lottie Lost]] [[Common Echoes|Common Echo]] and collects [[Sonance Casket: Ragunna|Sonance]] [[Sonance Casket: Septimont|Caskets]] from Rinascita.

==Trivia==
* Despite having its own unique name that shows above their in-game model, Teensy Weensy is often referred to as just "Lottie Lost" in the dialogue logs. One exception is {{Quest|Plushie Squad's Clean Return}}, where it is directly referred to as Teensy Weensy.
